description: This source file is a Java test class for the MapBasedDeviceConnectionService, specifically testing device gateway management methods such as setting and retrieving last known gateways, with emphasis on success, not found, and limit-reached scenarios.

classes.name: MapBasedDeviceConnectionServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for MapBasedDeviceConnectionService, focusing on device gateway management and limits.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, mocks dependencies, and creates an instance of MapBasedDeviceConnectionService.

methods.name: testSetAndGetLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Tests the ability to set and retrieve the last known gateway for a device, verifying correct status and payload.

methods.name: testGetLastKnownGatewayForDeviceNotFound
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving a gateway for a device with no existing entry results in a NOT_FOUND status.

methods.name: testSetLastKnownGatewayForDeviceFailsIfLimitReached
methods.description: Checks that setting a gateway fails with FORBIDDEN when the maximum devices per tenant is reached.
